name: Title card
description: A hardback whose cover is an early home-computer title card: black inside a thick orange frame banded on the spine side, a title of three chunky blocks in green, violet and blue, and white credit lines fringed violet on one side and green on the other, with a green ribbon and the page block’s white edge fringed the same way.
choices: The crack screen’s framed panel and multicoloured block title become a book cover, with credits in place of any group name
Colour fringes on every white edge mimic how hi-res white picks up green and violet; nothing is lettered
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold, plain outlined wordmark
